turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hi Leander, I can look that up once you share the order number and the email address used to place the order.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.
Sorry, I can’t look up or share order details by name. Please provide the order number and the email address used for the order.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.
I can’t share any order details without the order number and the email address used to place the order.
